events.description: Two players—one in a white Tampa Bay Lightning jersey (No. 37) and one in a red Washington Capitals jersey (No. 13)—engage in a mutual, sustained fistfight on the ice, exchanging punches while standing and leaning into each other.

A player in a white jersey is down on the ice near the boards, being restrained or attended to by referees; another player (No. 3, red jersey) stands over him, and at f5–f7 appears to push or shove the downed player while he is still on the ice and unable to defend himself.

Two hockey players—one in a white Tampa Bay Lightning jersey (No. 37) and one in a red Washington Capitals jersey (No. 13)—engage in a sustained, mutual fistfight on the ice, exchanging punches and grappling from start to finish of the clip, culminating in both falling to the ice at 43.5s.

Two players—one in red (Capitals #13) and one in white/blue (Lightning #37)—engage in a sustained physical fight on the ice, involving grappling, pushing, and attempts to throw each other off balance, culminating in both falling to the ice.

After both players are on the ice (f8–f9), the player in red (#13) delivers a punch or strike to the head/upper body of the downed player in white/blue (#37) while he is still on the ice and unable to defend effectively.

Players #13 (red) and #37 (white/blue) are back on their feet and continue to grapple and exchange shoves, with referees intervening to separate them; the physical confrontation persists until separation is achieved around 47.5s.

Two hockey players—one in red (Capitals #13) and one in white/blue (Tampa Bay #37)—engage in a physical altercation on the ice, including grappling, pushing, and attempted punches, while referees intervene to separate them.

Two players (Tampa Bay #37 in white and Washington #13 in red) are engaged in a physical altercation, with referees intervening to separate them. The red-jerseyed player appears to be striking or pushing the white-jerseyed player while being restrained.

After initial separation, the red-jerseyed player (#13) appears to deliver a punch or strike to the head/face of the white-jerseyed player (#37) while both are still in close contact and partially restrained by officials; the white player is not actively defending or retaliating at this moment.

Two players engage in close-quarters physical combat: a red-jerseyed player (No. 13) and a black-jerseyed opponent are seen grappling, with the red player appearing to be struck or pushed into the boards, followed by visible blood on his face and helmet contact.
After initial engagement, the red-jerseyed player (No. 13) is bent over and appears helpless while being struck or pressed against by the opponent; visible blood suggests injury during this phase.

Multiple players from opposing teams (red jerseys vs. white/blue jerseys) engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the boards, involving grappling, shoving, and attempts to strike; referees intervene throughout to separate combatants.
A player in red (No. 77, Oshie) delivers multiple punches to an opponent who is down on the ice and largely defenseless near the boards, while others are engaged in the surrounding fight.

Multiple players from both teams (red jerseys: Capitals; white/blue jerseys: Lightning) are engaged in a sustained physical altercation along the boards near the bench, involving grappling, shoving, and attempts to wrestle opponents to the ice. Referees intervene progressively to separate the combatants.
During the ongoing fight, a player in a red jersey (No. 77) appears to deliver repeated strikes to an opponent who is on the ice and largely defenseless, consistent with attacking a helpless victim.
Two ice hockey players engage in a sustained physical altercation, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving while on skates; helmets are dislodged during the struggle.
